AirPods Pro 3 持續減價 50 美元之際，今日 9to5Toys 午間速報嘅重頭戲係鈦金屬錶殼 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 減 184 美元、鋁金屬 GPS + 流動網絡型號減 130 美元，其他型號由 299 美元起。罕見嘅 Apple 鍵盤同黑色 Magic Mouse 優惠（不知何故）仍然有效，我哋亦有好推介嘅 Anker Prime 充電池（兼任牆插充電器）折扣，但今日真正嘅配件亮點係 Nomad 嘅大型週年紀念全站大減價，MagSafe 充電器、手機殼、Find My 追蹤卡、Watch 錶帶等都有罕見優惠。詳情請繼續睇落去。

AirPods Pro 3 remain discounted by $50 with summer pricing starting from $99 across more models

  • AirPods Pro 3 — $200 (orig. $249)
  • AirPods 4 — $99 (orig. $129)
  • AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation — $149 (orig. $179)

Back in stock: titanium 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 now $184 off at Amazon

This deal sold out very quickly yesterday, so if you were interested, definitely don’t sleep on it today. The Apple titanium Slate 46mm GPS + cellular Series 11 is once again $184 off at Amazon.

Amazon is now shipping the 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + cellular with a titanium Slate case and Black Sport Band for $564.97.

This is one of the top-of-the-line titanium case models at $749. Today’s (presumably very brief) deal takes $184 off, making it one of the best prices we’ve tracked on this model. It briefly dipped to $550 right before Prime Day last month, but aside from that, this is the best price we’ve seen on this configuration.

It’s worth noting that this deal is only for those set on this particular beautiful titanium case and Slate colorway, as even with the discount, the price isn’t cheap. That said, the more popular aluminum models in the Series 11 lineup also got $100 and $130 price cuts this week:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 — $299 (orig. $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 — $329 (orig. $429)
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + cellular — from $399 (orig. $499)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + cellular — from $399 (orig. $529)

Rare Apple Keyboard and Black Magic Mouse deals (for some reason) still live, with prices starting from $80 at all-time lows

We certainly see plenty of deals on the most popular Apple products — AirPods Pro 3 down to $50 off, the most popular Apple Watch Series 11 models at up to $130 off — but Magic accessories are far less common. However, we’re (for some reason) still seeing extended Prime Day price drops on the base Magic Keyboard, the full-size model with Touch ID, as well as the Black Apple Magic Mouse.

Before these extended Prime Day discounts, deals on these Apple accessories were extremely rare, and how much longer they’ll stick around is anyone’s guess.

  • Black Apple Magic Mouse — $80 (orig. $99)
  • Apple Magic Keyboard — $80 (orig. $99)
  • Apple Magic Keyboard with Touch ID, full-size — $145 (orig. $179)

All three are the lowest prices we’ve ever tracked at Amazon. It’s been a long time since we’ve seen the Black Apple Magic Mouse drop to this price (I’ve been thinking about picking up a backup myself), and both Magic Keyboard models are at new all-time lows — the base model has only seen this price during this round of discounts, while the Touch ID model has never dropped below $158.

If you’re looking to upgrade your Apple Magic input devices, these lingering Prime Day deals are still live, so don’t miss out.

Nomad’s big anniversary sitewide sale now live: rare deals on MagSafe chargers, cases, Watch bands, more

Rare 20% off: Nomad’s metal and glass 25W Qi2 MagSafe charging stands

There are tons of 25W Qi2 MagSafe charging stands on the market these days, but when it comes to build quality and aesthetics, almost none compare to the latest from Nomad. Although they don’t come cheap, we’re now tracking rare price drops on both the 2-in-1 and 3-in-1 models just in time for the brand’s 2026 anniversary sale kicking off, covering your entire Apple carry setup.

Nomad’s 2026 anniversary sale is now live with deals across iPhone 17 cases, wallets, Apple Watch bands, and other charging accessories, but the deals on the Stand One and Stand One Max are among the rarest:

  • Nomad 2-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One — $103 (orig. $129)
  • Nomad 3-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One Max — $135 (orig. $169)

You’re looking at Nomad’s latest generation 25W Qi2 MagSafe charging stands, currently 20% off. Doesn’t sound like much, but these essentially never go on sale.

We’re talking about premium solid metal construction with substantial weight, paired with glass finishes to provide an elegant, luxurious home for your Apple gear.

The only downside with today’s discount is that the new Cosmic Orange colorway isn’t included in the deal:

Rare price drops: Nomad Tracking Card lineup — Apple Find My Pro, Google Find Hub, more

Nomad’s anniversary sale is now live, and while the Tracking Card Pro and Air briefly appeared to go on sale erroneously, they’re now officially live. The discounts aren’t massive, but we’re talking about rare price drops here, with both the Apple Find My and Google Find Hub versions starting from $32.

Nomad’s Tracking Cards are easily among the best of their kind, featuring wireless MagSafe charging — I carry one with me every time I leave the house:

  • Tracking Card Air — $32 (orig. $35), Apple Find My or Google Find Hub
  • Tracking Card Pro — $41 (orig. $45), available in all three colors

20% off Nomad Titanium Stratos Apple Watch bands for anniversary sale (rare discount)

My favorite! Anker Prime power bank with display that doubles as a wall charger falls to just $70 for summer sale

Anker’s 2026 summer sale continues with discounts across the brand’s latest Prime charging lineup, power banks, desktop chargers, 25W MagSafe stands, and more. One of my personal favorite portable charging products has also dropped back to its 2026 low of $69.99 — the 9,600mAh Anker Prime power bank that doubles as a wall charger.

The 9,600mAh Anker Prime power bank is now shipping from Amazon for $69.99. Originally priced as high as $90, we’ve tracked this deal a few times this year, but given that it’s been popping up this week, we wanted to highlight it again because it’s become one of the most useful pieces of gear in my portable charging kit, having used it for nearly a year now.

There are indeed larger capacity and faster charging power banks in the brand’s newer lineup, but this one is incredibly practical for me. As one of the more compact models, it easily fits in my carry-on bag, yet still offers a smart display, USB-C ports, and enough juice to handle a day out or multiple days of charging needs.

For my full hands-on review, head over here.

It’s also one of the few models in the lineup that doubles as a wall charger. There are fold-out prongs on the back of the power bank that let it charge its internal battery while also functioning as a wall charger — I genuinely love this design, as it means not having to pack an extra piece of gear.

Today’s accessory and charging deals:

  • This 140W 4-port charger can power your entire setup for just $35 (41% off)
  • Dual Qi charging mouse pad now $30 (was $70), easily charges your iPhone and AirPods
  • This 250W Anker Prime charging station with LCD display can replace six chargers, now just $95
  • Belkin 100W USB-C GaN wall charger hits Amazon all-time low at $25.50

  • Add four Matter-certified Edison bulbs to your Apple, Google, or Alexa smart home for under $8 each
  • Add premium Matter-enabled atmospheric lighting to your home with Govee’s 3-pack Permanent Outdoor Lights Prism, from $430
  • Add this DOCKCASE 2-in-1 USB-C SD card reader to your tech bag for just $7 (47% off)
  • Rare deal! Belkin 25W UltraCharge Pro 3-in-1 MagSafe charger hits Amazon all-time low
  • Still live: Anker’s latest 45W Nano charger with smart display now just $26 (all colors)
  • UGREEN FineTrack Slim Find My wallet tracker with MagSafe charging now just $18 today
  • This magnetic Apple Watch band can be yours for just $20 today (41% off)
  • Anker’s 10-port flat plug power strip now down to $20 at Amazon

Still live: Anker’s 3-port 160W smart display charger back to Prime Day pricing (33% off), with other models from $8

In addition to ongoing discounts on Anker’s Qi2 25W smart charger with display and the latest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging station, we’ve also tracked its 160W 3-port Prime charger with display dropping back to Prime Day pricing (33% off).

Amazon’s official Anker storefront is now shipping the Smart Display 3-port Prime charger for $99.99.

For something that’s essentially a wall charger, the price isn’t exactly cheap, but it features a built-in smart display, can deliver up to 160W of output, and is ‘about the size of an AirPods Pro 3 charging case, making it portable enough to carry with you while still powerful enough to handle all your devices.’

More specifically, it can deliver up to 140W output through a single USB-C port, capable of ‘charging a 16-inch MacBook Pro from 0 to 50% in 25 minutes.’

As for the smart display, it features AnkerSense View technology that can ‘monitor power levels in real-time on the screen, instantly switch modes, and unlock custom modes via the app over Bluetooth.’
